notes: IFRS as adopted by the EU for every year from FY2007 to FY2025 (Schneider Electric moved to IFRS in 2005, so no standard change falls inside this window). Reporting currency EUR throughout; fiscal year ends December 31.

** 2-for-1 share split in 2011. Shares in issue went from 271,959,091 at Dec 31, 2010 to 548,943,024 at Dec 31, 2011. dilutedEPS, dividendPerShare and sharesOutstanding for FY2007-FY2010 are the figures the company published at the time (pre-split) and are NOT comparable with FY2011 onwards; no post-split restatement of those years exists in any document found, so none was computed.

Field definitions: revenue = 'Revenue' on the consolidated income statement (the 2008 report labels the same line 'Revenue'); operatingIncome = 'Operating income' ('Operating profit' in the 2008 report) i.e. after amortisation and impairment of purchase-accounting intangibles, before net financial income - it is NOT 'Adjusted EBITA' (which excludes restructuring, other operating income/expenses and PPA amortisation and is higher); netIncome = profit attributable to owners of the parent; totalEquity = equity attributable to owners of the parent; cashAndEquivalents = 'Cash and cash equivalents' on the balance sheet (Schneider's cash-flow statement reports a slightly different 'net cash and cash equivalents'); totalDebt = 'TOTAL CURRENT AND NON-CURRENT FINANCIAL LIABILITIES' (bonds, bank borrowings, commercial paper, accrued interest, bank overdrafts, short-term portion of debt), i.e. gross financial debt, excluding pension provisions and purchase commitments over non-controlling interests, which the company reports separately in its net-debt table; operatingCashFlow = 'TOTAL I - CASH FLOWS FROM OPERATING ACTIVITIES' (after the change in working capital), not the 'net cash provided by operating activities' line shown before the working-capital movement; capex = purchases of property, plant and equipment + purchases of intangible assets, stored negative - Schneider reports the two on separate lines and does not net proceeds from disposals; dividendPerShare = net dividend per share in respect of the fiscal year (the proposed dividend where it had not yet been approved when the report was published).

employees = the Group average number of permanent and temporary employees ('TOTAL AVERAGE WORKFORCE' in note 25 of recent URDs, 'TOTAL AVERAGE NUMBER OF EMPLOYEES' in the notes of the 2008-2017 reports), not the year-end head count (e.g. 162,970 average vs 159,844 head count at Dec 31, 2025). From FY2024 the definition excludes non-employee interim workers; FY2024 therefore uses the 158,635 restated in the 2025 URD (the 2024 URD published 176,962 including 18,809 interim workers).
sharesOutstanding = 'Number of shares in issue' at December 31 from the Article L.232-8 five-year table of the parent company (not the weighted average used for EPS).

Restatements applied (each year is taken from the latest document that shows it): FY2009 restated in the 2010 report (net income attributable 852 -> 824; total assets 25,649 -> 25,632; equity attributable 11,757 -> 11,729); FY2011 restated in the 2012 report; FY2012 restated in the 2013 report (net income 1,840 -> 1,813; diluted EPS 3.36 -> 3.31; total assets 36,156 -> 36,150; equity 16,642 -> 16,653); FY2013 restated in the 2014 report for discontinued operations (revenue 23,551 -> 23,392; operating income 3,091 -> 3,039; total assets 36,988 -> 37,349; equity 17,212 -> 17,211; cash 5,528 -> 5,563; total financial liabilities 8,859 -> 8,889; operating cash flow 2,901 -> 2,866; capex -822 -> -814); FY2016 restated in the 2017 report (revenue 24,693 -> 24,459; operating income 2,951 -> 2,975; operating cash flow 2,970 -> 2,957; capex -859 -> -836; average workforce 170,866 -> 160,924).

FY2007 and FY2008 come from the 2008 Registration Document (the earliest one still published by the company), FY2009-FY2010 from the 2010 document, FY2011 from the 2012 document, FY2012 from the 2013 document and FY2013-FY2014 from the 2014 document; from FY2015 each year is taken from its own annual/universal registration document, except FY2016 (from the 2017 report, which restates it) and FY2024 (from the 2025 URD, for the restated workforce).

Dividend anomaly: the five-year table in the 2022 URD prints 2.63 as the FY2022 net dividend per share, which contradicts its own 'dividends paid' row and the 2023, 2024 and 2025 URDs (all 3.15), and the 2023 URD's text states 'In 2023, the Group paid out the 2022 dividend of EUR 3.15 per share'. FY2022 uses 3.15.

Yahoo cross-check (FY2022-FY2025): the snapshot values are in USD. Revenue and net income imply the same EUR/USD rate for each year (1.052 for 2022, 1.085 for 2023, 1.080 for 2024, 1.132 for 2025), so the lines, units and scope match and the whole gap is currency conversion.
